latest.notes:
Fixes the Software Update pane showing an out-of-date release.

• The pane checked for updates only once per launch, so a Mac left running for weeks kept showing whatever was true the first time it was opened — which is how a station five releases behind reported only one available. It now checks each time you open it.
• A check is never started while an update is downloading or installing.

Includes everything in v0.5.74: the scheduling fixes for songs returning too soon across midnight, song identity, rotation variety, the new Variety and Diagnostics settings, and faster log generation.
